input: Learn to identify edible mushrooms safely with a guide

gold.taskTitle: Learn to Identify Edible Mushrooms Safely With a Guide
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to learn how to identify edible mushrooms safely, using some form of guide or guidance resource.

questions.title: What region or country will you be foraging in?
questions.description: Understanding the geographic location helps determine which mushroom species are relevant and which guides are most accurate for local flora.

questions.title: Are you a complete beginner or have some prior knowledge?
questions.description: Knowing the user's current skill level helps tailor the learning path, from absolute basics to more advanced identification techniques.

questions.title: Do you prefer a book, app, or in-person guide?
questions.description: Identifying the preferred format of the guide (field book, mobile app, or a human expert/foraging group) shapes the recommended resources.

questions.title: Is your goal to forage wild mushrooms or recognize them generally?
questions.description: Clarifying whether the user intends to actually collect and eat wild mushrooms versus simply being able to identify them for safety or curiosity purposes.

questions.title: Do you have a specific mushroom species you want to start with?
questions.description: Some beginners target beginner-friendly species like chanterelles or oyster mushrooms; knowing this helps focus the learning plan.

questions.title: What is your target timeline for learning this skill?
questions.description: Understanding whether the user wants to be ready in weeks, a season, or a year helps structure the pace and depth of the plan.

questions.title: Are you open to joining a local foraging club or walk?
questions.description: Determining willingness to participate in community or guided group foraging events, which are widely considered the safest way to learn identification.
